data.title: Support multi-bug context for Claude
data.body:
## Goal

Allow Claude to work with multiple related bugs simultaneously.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Support `DOCKET_BUGS` environment variable (comma-separated IDs)
- [ ] `docket work ID1 ID2 ID3` sets up multi-bug context
- [ ] `docket show --related` shows bugs related to current bug
- [ ] Update `/docket-implement` skill to handle multiple bugs
- [ ] Consider: automatic detection of related bugs via tags or dependencies

## Context

Sometimes bugs are closely related and it's helpful to work on them together. Currently `DOCKET_BUG` is singular. A `DOCKET_BUGS` variable would let Claude know about related context.

Lower priority: single-bug workflow works well. This is for advanced use cases.

## Log
